gaps.title: Themes repeat one cell instead of having a tune
gaps.detail: overworld.js bars 5-12 are a D major triad run plus a scale walk in straight quarters, bars 9-12 are those same bars transposed a tone, and that four-bar cell returns verbatim on solo horn and trumpet. Nine distinct bar-rhythms across 38 bars, 58 percent plain quarters. Rewrite as a real period: signature dotted or syncopated march rhythm opening on a leap, plus a different consequent that answers and cadences. Same rule for village and battle.

events.note: overworld.js: the four-bar cell no longer returns verbatim. A' (bars 12-19) is a written ornamented variation for the solo horn - the opening turn D5 E5 F#5 A5 answers the chorus's leap, bar 5 turns onto a seventh where the chorus names the fourth, bar 7 keeps the dotted descent but comes to rest on a D an octave below, and the cadence lands a sixth instead of a bare fourth over a D triad. A" (bars 28-35) is the brass variation: bar 1's dotted figure runs to the barline (leaving it short slid every bar half a beat late into the Tag), bar 3 lands on C# rather than A, bar 5 returns to the tonic instead of a ninth above it, bar 6 peaks a fourth below the chorus, and bar 8 hammers the low D in held chords. Measured: no two statements share a four-bar cell; each hands over exactly on its own downbeat (horn bar 20, tutti bar 36, oboe stops at 23.75 so the flute can answer); 0 melody/harmony clashes of 77 strong-beat checks (was 2 - the legato glide was playing notes in neither the line nor the chord, so bars 12-16 now play detached); form intact, no note past the loop end, 11 independent hand-written lines, max doubling 47%. Live scenario 20/23, 0 console/page/network errors - the 3 remaining failures are pre-existing at HEAD: title theme's 2 strong-beat clashes, and overworld generatedPct=4 and bassStepPct=36 which fail at HEAD too.

Measured on the built theme, not on the file's own header. (1) No two A-statements share a four-bar cell: horn bars 12-15 vs violins 4-7, trumpets 28-31 vs violins 4-7, trumpets 28-31 vs horn 12-15, horn 16-19 vs trumpets 32-35 all differ. (2) Every statement hands over on its own downbeat: horn ends bar 20.00, tutti bar 36.00, oboe bar 23.75 (stopping so the flute can answer), flute bar 28.00. (3) checkHarmony: 0 clashes of 77 strong-beat checks, down from 2 at HEAD - the legato glide was playing pitches in neither the written line nor the chord, so the horn's bars 12-16 play detached. (4) Form intact: intro 4 + loop 34 = 38 bars, 898 events, none past the loop end. (5) counterpoint: 11 independent hand-written lines, max melody-doubling 47%, overrun 0. (6) Live scenarios/P27.json on demos/P27.html: 20/23 assertions, 0 consoleErrors, 0 pageErrors, 0 failedRequests, 118 fps avg. The 3 remaining failures are NOT this piece and are pre-existing at HEAD - confirmed by building the HEAD version of overworld.js in isolation: title theme has 2 strong-beat clashes (bars 17-18, violins), and overworld already measured generatedPct=4 and bassStepPct=36 at HEAD against thresholds of 2 and 45.

PLAYER CHECK, 2026-09-30: the tester listened to the overworld theme at demos/P27.html and said it passes. This is the one verification an agent cannot supply - none of us can hear - so it stands as the human's own sign-off on the result, alongside the measurements already recorded (0 clashes of 77 strong-beat checks, no shared four-bar cell, form intact).
